scenes.title: Pick a Game
scenes.narr: Baby Games has three simple games for little ones during service.

scenes.title: Squish!
scenes.narr: In Squish, babies tap the colourful bubbles to pop them.

scenes.title: God Loves You
scenes.narr: Bible Squish fills the screen with hearts and God's love.

scenes.title: Rainbow Draw
scenes.narr: In God's Rainbow Drawing, they scribble in bright colours.

scenes.title: Grown-Ups Only
scenes.narr: A simple exit code keeps little fingers safely in the game.
